payload.title: File:Silveirinha Formation.png
payload.description_html: Reconstruction of the environment of the Silveirinha Formation (in Portugal) as it would have appeared during the Early Eocene. Species included are Archaeonycteris? praecursor, Vitis sp., Arcius zbyszewskii, Gymnospermae indet., Leptacodon nascimentoi, Geiseltaliellus sp., Diacodexis antunesi, Fluviatilavis antunesi, Lophiaspis maurettei, Neochelys sp., Diplocynodon sp., Nitellopsis dutemplei, Percichthyidae indet., Mondegodon eutrigonus, Teilhardimys reisi and Dunnophis matronensis.
